name: road_boulder

interaction.note: south (bottom) side, facing north; the push rolls the boulder east to its resting spot

note: place on a 3-tile-wide dirt road (both 96x64, one scale/palette, bottom-aligned; swap image + collision). `collision` = closed state (full road width, all 3 tiles). Closed paint is wedged mossy stone across all three tiles (handprint stays on the main rock; no side footpath, no baked dirt). Open: turned-over resting stone foot only (opaque core ≈ x64–92,y30–56) so the left two tiles stay a clear passage for feet/A*; the previous pad (58,16,38×48) pinched that lane. Dirt patch is a soft decal; stones are opaque with outline + shadow.
